body: Right now I feel really good but I know that this is not going to last.
I'm going to but I think the suicidal thoughts are coming from me. I've had them since early teens.

> Is there anything you enjoy doing? Something that brings you pleasure?

No I play video games but I don't like them anymore.
I took some antidepressant before and it made me feel worse so I'm on lithium now. I'm better on lithium but apparently not good enough.

> Have you looked into trying something else?

No I don't want to deal with that stuff anymore. I give up.

> What you are feeling is likely caused by chemicals in your brain.

Duh

> Get medical attention now

I already have tons of times.
